messages:
emily_cs: FYI renewal docs from ACME are in. Procurement attached a PO and asked for a 12mo term + 10% discount. Need quick legal/finance check before I send for signature. PO link: https://acme.example/po/9843 :paperclip:

aaron_ae: Thanks. We already offered 5% in the playbook for renewals. 10% is higher — did they give a rationale?

emily_cs: They said market pressures and wanting price stability. Also asked to move billing start to next invoice cycle (Apr 1).

sam_finance: 10% exceeds my approval cap. If we do anything >7% it needs finance VP signoff. Could we meet them at 8% with annual prepay or reserved capacity?

pat_legal: Need to check procurement redlines — they added a 'termination for convenience' clause with 30d notice. We usually only allow termination for cause. Proposed compromise below.

pat_legal: ```
Proposed amendment:
"Termination for convenience: Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice, provided Customer pays a pro-rated amount for the unused portion of pre-paid fees and any non-cancellable third-party costs incurred by Redwood Inference."
```

emily_cs: @pat_legal that wording looks reasonable. @sam_finance can you sign off on 8% + 12mo + pro-rated termination language? If yes I'll push to e-sign.

sadia_acme: (ACME procurement) we prefer 10% but are willing to accept 8% if the termination language is cleaned up as above and billing moves to 4/1. Need countersigned by next week.

sam_finance: 8% is OK if it's net30 and not prepaid. If they prepay we can do 9%. I'll approve 8% with the pro-rated termination and standard indemnities.

aaron_ae: Great. I'll update the contract: change discount to 8%, add Pat's termination clause, set effective billing start 2025-04-01, and keep net30.\/ Will drop final version in this thread. :pencil2:

olivia_enablement: Heads-up: onboarding kickoff depends on signature. If we sign by 4/1 I can schedule enablement week starting 4/8. If it slips past 4/7 we won't be able to ship initial training until mid-April.

emily_cs: Noted. Priority is to get this signed this week. Aaron, ping me when you drop the contract.

aaron_ae: Dropping updated contract now (see snippet).

aaron_ae: ```
Summary of changes:
- Discount: 8% off list
- Term: 12 months
- Billing start date: 2025-04-01
- Payment terms: Net30
- Termination clause: inserted pro-rated termination for convenience
```

aaron_ae: @e-sign-bot please prepare DocuSign envelope for sign-off when I upload the PDF.

 e-sign-bot: Auto: DocuSign envelope will be created when the document is uploaded. I will post the envelope link here. :robot_face:

emily_cs: Perfect. I'll shepherd this. If VP finance needs any context I can send the ACME ROI + usage deck.

sam_finance: If anything changes (they push again to 10%) hold until I loop in VP. Otherwise, good to proceed.

sadia_acme: Thanks everyone. We'll review the final and aim to sign by Friday. :thumbsup:

aaron_ae: Uploaded final PDF to the e-sign flow. Link (DocuSign): https://docusign.example/envelope/7a9b

 e-sign-bot: Envelope created and sent to signers. Status: Sent.

emily_cs: Timeline check — looking to have signed copy in hand by EOD Friday. Olivia, prep onboarding materials for 4/8 contingent on signature.

olivia_enablement: Will do. Blocking items: SSO setup needs updated admin contact from ACME (Sadia), can you share?

sadia_acme: I'll send admin contact in DM.

emily_cs: Thanks. Closing loop here unless there are new redlines.

pat_legal: Adding one small note — we'll add a reference to the standard data processing addendum (DPA) as an exhibit. No change to commercial terms.

aaron_ae: Acknowledged, I added DPA ref.

emily_cs: Great job team. I'll update the renewal tracker and mark as "sent to e-sign". :white_check_mark:
